project.work_name: Construction of CC road, Ward 7, Danapur
project.description: Construction of cement concrete road in Ward 7, Danapur municipality, Patna district

evidence.headline: Cost 3.4x higher than comparable works
evidence.detail: Cost per km is 42.0 L against a peer median of 12.4 L for 1,240 comparable road works in Bihar (robust z = 3.4)

evidence.headline: 84% funds released against 30% physical progress
evidence.detail: 84% of funds released against 30% reported physical progress - a 54 percentage point gap where the peer median gap is 6 pp

evidence.headline: 3 releases within 11 days totalling 84% of sanction
evidence.detail: 3 releases within 11 days totalling 84% of sanction, before the 50% progress milestone

evidence.headline: 0.89 similarity to MPL-BR-2024-0388
evidence.detail: 0.89 description similarity to MPL-BR-2024-0388, same district, same agency, sanctioned 41 days apart, cost ratio 1.08

evidence.headline: 214 days past category median completion window
evidence.detail: 214 days past the category median completion window; risk score rose from 52 to 87 over the last two months
